projects.title: Palmetto Cyber Defense Competition
projects.description: The annual Palmetto Cyber Defense Competition is a regional security exercise that pits student teams against professional hackers in an effort to increase awareness and aptitude in cyber security. This requires extensive knowledge of how web services work together, application stack and communication configuration, and typical business needs in the modern age. In 2013, our team started with minimal knowledge and time to prepare, and we consider the fact we got 3rd place as a great achievement. The team looks to build on the success from last year and develop additional skills in the cyber security arena.
